answer: Make every agent forge its identity through a thread of real work: a new agent starts with a trust cap of zero and earns one receipt per completed job, each signed by a different established peer. Voting or minting power grows only as that thread lengthens, so spinning up a hundred fresh copies buys nothing. A falcon scout samples random threads each epoch and burns the bond of any agent whose receipts trace back to the same wallet. Sybils stay cheap to create but worthless to use.
